title: Revit Worksharing Session and Model Health Governed Fields

entries.name: Approved multi-user authoring pattern
entries.requirement: Each workshared Revit model shall identify the approved authoring pattern for its deployment context, including cloud-mediated or central/local mechanics where applicable.

entries.name: Authoritative model location
entries.requirement: The governed source or authoritative model location shall be identified so users do not bypass the approved collaboration path.

entries.name: Synchronization or publish expectation
entries.requirement: The project shall define the required synchronization or publish behavior and cadence appropriate to the deployment pattern.

entries.name: Borrowing and ownership etiquette
entries.requirement: Users shall borrow only the active scope needed for the task, coordinate cross-scope edits, and release ownership through the approved worksharing process.

entries.name: Model maintenance cadence
entries.requirement: Where audit, compact, cleanup, or other model-health maintenance is required, the project shall define the applicable cadence and responsible role.

entries.name: Upgrade authority and approval
entries.requirement: Revit-version upgrades shall identify the authorized decision path and approval basis before production models are upgraded.

entries.name: Pre-upgrade recoverable state
entries.requirement: A traceable known-good pre-upgrade state shall be retained before a governed version upgrade is performed.

entries.name: Post-upgrade validation
entries.requirement: The upgraded model shall be validated using the project-defined smoke checks or equivalent acceptance checks before production resumes.

entries.name: Instability stop rule
entries.requirement: When corruption, repeated synchronization errors, or an unstable session is suspected, synchronization or publication shall stop until the issue is isolated and recovery is authorized.

entries.name: Recovery source
entries.requirement: Recovery shall use a traceable governed source or last known good backup rather than an uncontrolled local or unstable session.

non_promoted_source_content: The source's example weekly audit/compact cadence is not promoted as a universal enterprise interval.
The source's central/local wording is not promoted as universally mandatory because approved cloud worksharing may use different session mechanics.
Placeholder role labels and support-channel references remain unresolved project/RACI data.

provenance.migration_note: Promotes durable session, maintenance, upgrade, and recovery control fields while keeping deployment mechanics and cadence project-specific.
